cohort: The study included 423 patients who desired postpartum permanent contraception and delivered at West Virginia University Hospital in 2019 and 2021.
finding: West Virginia's policy change may have partially reduced a barrier to inpatient postpartum permanent contraception access, as Medicaid fulfillment rates remained stable while non-Medicaid fulfillment rates decreased, leading to no significant difference between insurance types by 2021.
gest_age: deliveries at 20 weeks of gestation or more
